team.added.description: Items of your team's library you added on this computer (their ids). Kept here by the team's commands; it never syncs.
team.added.title: Added from the team's library

team.off.description: Defaults of your team's library you turned off on this computer (their ids). Kept here by the team's commands; it never syncs. An item your team requires stays on whatever is listed here.
team.off.title: Turned off from the team's library

team.shareOnlyVerified.description: Share your projects only with teammates whose fingerprint you compared (marked as verified in the Sync tab, under Team, People). Off: every teammate with a key can read what you share. Kept on this computer; it never syncs.
team.shareOnlyVerified.title: Share only with verified teammates

team.shareNotices.description: Say so once, quietly, when a teammate shares a project (or its chats) with you, or asks you to share one. Off: nothing is announced; what your team shares is still listed in the Sync tab, under Team.
team.shareNotices.title: Tell me when a teammate shares something
